data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The nocturnal UHI is primarily governed by a positive feedback between daytime aridity and night-time longwave trapping: impervious urban surfaces lack moisture, so daytime sensible heat storage is converted to nocturnal longwave emission, which is then partially re-absorbed by the street canyon geometry; cross-city variation in the night-time gap therefore scales with both urban aridity (less irrigation) and built density (street canyons).","counterconditions":[{"case":"If high-aridity cities with low building density (high sky view) exhibit night-time UHI similar to non-arid cities, the aridity-canyon feedback fails as a primary cross-city modulator.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If densely built cities with extensive irrigation (low aridity) exhibit night-time UHI comparable to dense, arid cities, the aridity component is redundant to built density.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If urban/rural sky view factor differences do not linearly predict longwave radiation trapping and cooling rates, the geometric trapping mechanism fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If rural longwave cooling rates are found to be primarily governed by wind speed and atmospheric humidity rather than surface emissivity and sky view, the feedback model is incomplete.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"1) Reduced urban evapotranspiration shifts daytime heat partitioning from latent to sensible storage, increasing urban heat content. 2) After sunset, stored heat releases as longwave radiation. 3) The sky view factor (SVF) of the urban canyon traps this longwave radiation, recycling it to the surface. The result is a feedback loop: aridity maximizes stored sensible heat, canyon geometry delays its nocturnal dissipation.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
